newsitem.title: USA: Mattel -Tyco merger cleared by FTC.
newsitem.headline: Mattel -Tyco merger cleared by FTC.

text.p: Mattel Inc said Thursday its merger with Tyco Toys Inc had been approved by the Federal Trade Commission, and the companies plan to consummate the deal by March 31.
Mattel said the result of the Tyco integration and Mattel's restructuring would be a one-time, pre-tax charge of about $275 million, to be taken in the first quarter.
The integration and restructuring will also result in the elimination of about 2,700 positions worldwide by the combined companies, Mattel said.
Mattel said it expects cost savings of more than $700 million over the next five years, and about $60 million in the rest of 1997.

The integration and restructuring charge will include expenses for transaction fees related to the merger, a realignment of U.S. and international operations, limited disposition of certain businesses, and overhead reduction, Mattel said.
